entries.original: Code mode can now call standalone web search directly, including from nested JavaScript tool calls, and receive plaintext search results. (#26719)
entries.translated: [codex] 코드 모드에서 독립형 웹 검색 활성화

entries.original: Tool and connector input schemas now preserve `oneOf` and `allOf`, and large schemas keep more shallow structure when compacted, improving compatibility with richer MCP tools. (#24118, #27084)
entries.translated: V2 에이전트 상주 LRU 추가

entries.original: `codex doctor` now includes editor and pager environment details in the local report while redacting raw values in JSON output. (#27081)
entries.translated: Proc-macro-error2 권고 무시

entries.original: Plugin marketplace automation is more informative and responsive: `codex plugin marketplace list --json` now includes each marketplace source, and plugin lists can return from the cached remote catalog before refreshing in the background. (#27009, #26932)
entries.translated: 활성 실행 기준 V2 동시성 계산

entries.original: `codex resume --last "..."` and `codex fork --last "..."` now treat the trailing argument as the initial prompt instead of misreading it as a session ID. (#26818)
entries.translated: 멀티 에이전트 v2의 close_agent를 interrupt_agent로 이름 변경

entries.original: MCP startup warnings from subagents now stay in the thread that owns them, avoiding duplicate parent-thread alerts and stuck startup spinners in the TUI. (#26639)
entries.translated: 재개 시 v2 하위 항목의 재오픈 방지

entries.original: Image edits now use the exact referenced image file paths instead of guessing from conversation history, so attached-image edits land on the intended input. (#26486)
entries.translated: [codex] 메모리에서 외부 도구 출력 제외

entries.original: Bare URLs with `~` in the path are now linkified end to end in the TUI instead of being truncated before the tilde. (#27088)
entries.translated: [codex] 라인 테이블이 포함된 릴리스 심볼 아티팩트 복구

entries.original: Thread resets such as `/new`, `/clear`, and `/fork` no longer drop cloud-managed requirements or feature flags during TUI config reloads. (#25177)
entries.translated: 연결 정리 차단 방지

entries.original: Sandbox execution now preserves approved escalation decisions and enforces configured proxy-only networking more consistently. (#24981, #27035)
entries.translated: Responses 클라이언트 메타데이터에 HTTP 윈도우 ID 추가

entries.original: Release builds once again publish separate symbol archives with line tables, improving post-release crash symbolication without bringing back the earlier full-debug build slowdown. (#26202)
entries.translated: [codex-analytics] 컴팩션 분석 세부 정보 보고
